story:
Amy and Mom sit on the floor. [emotion:QT/happy] They have big red blocks. Amy wants to build blocks. Mom says, "Let's build blocks together." [gesture:clapping] Amy picks up red blocks. She places a big block. Mom is stacking blocks. Amy is putting blocks. [emotion:QT/happy]

They build a tall tower. The blocks are red and blue. Amy puts a little block on top. Mom adds more blocks. The tower gets very high. Suddenly, the blocks tumble! [emotion:QT/surprised] *Clatter!* The blocks fall down. [emotion:QT/sad] Amy looks at the fallen blocks. Mom kneels down. [emotion:QT/calm] "We can build again," Mom says. "Let's stack blocks together."

Amy picks up blue blocks. Mom helps Amy put them on. [gesture:peekaboo] Amy stacks a piece. Mom stacks a piece. They work together. They build big towers. They build little towers. [emotion:QT/happy]

Finally, they finish the tower. It is strong! Mom gives Amy a hug. [gesture:embrace] "You are so helpful, Amy," Mom says. Amy feels proud. [emotion:QT/happy] They look at the blocks. They built many blocks together. Playing blocks is fun. [gesture:nodding-yes]

The tall block tower has suddenly tumbled down, scattering blocks on the floor. Amy looks at the fallen blocks while Mom kneels beside her.
